Laura / Steph — I pulled the onboarding logs for DocuTrust (external id: DT-0071). Symptoms look like a tenant-claim collision: there is an existing supplier profile that was previously claimed using an email under docutrust.io. When the new invite to procurement@docutrust.com is accepted the service checks tenant bindings and returns the 'Account already claimed' path.

Options:
- Ask the vendor to accept the invite using the original claiming email (if they still control it).
- Perform a manual tenant-release on our side and rebind the new email to the supplier profile — requires explicit consent from DocuTrust to avoid accidental data merge. This is what I recommend given time pressure.

If we do manual release, my plan (estimated ~4-48h depending on queue):
1) Create internal support ticket and snapshot current supplier profile.
2) Notify vendor with consent form to choose between merge vs new profile.
3) If vendor confirms new profile, perform release and resend invite.
4) Validate PO visibility in merchant view and confirm with procurement.

I'm attaching the support stub (SUP-9982) and will open a proper ticket after we get vendor consent. Anything else I should list in the consent doc?

- Ben
